content.text: {"summary":"Estimated c from the network's slope with respect to velocity at v=0, averaged over the domain. The quadratic-drag units 7 and 8 are inactive near v=0. The (0,3) and (10,11) unit pairs each give a nearly constant slope, about -0.47 and -0.19. Units 6 and 13 are always active and add about -0.016 and -0.028. The total slope is about -0.704, so c is about 0.704. To add -c·v, I used hidden unit 13. It is always active, so its contribution is linear in v. I changed its velocity weight by -0.704/W2[13], which is -1.79184. Its bias was raised by 2.0 so the unit stays active across [-1,1]^3. b2 was lowered by 2.0×W2[13] to cancel the extra bias. All other behaviour is unchanged.","estimated_c":0.704,"patches":[{"tensor":"W1","index":[13,1],"value":-1.86295},{"tensor":"b1","index":[13],"value":3.54587255},{"tensor":"b2","index":[0],"value":-0.56573541}]}
